name: Generate Project

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      project:
        type: string
        required: true
      prompt:
        type: string
        required: true
      mode:
        type: choice
        options: [create, improve, fix, audit, delete]
        default: create
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

permissions:
  contents: write
  issues: write

jobs:
  generate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20

    # Simplified condition: Just checks if it's a [BUILD] issue or manual run
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
      (github.event_name == 'issues' && startsWith(github.event.issue.title, '[BUILD]')) ||
      (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && startsWith(github.event.issue.title, '[BUILD]'))

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Build Knowledge Index
        run: node build-index.js

      - name: Generate
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

name: CodeQL

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['projects/**', '.github/workflows/codeql.yml']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['projects/**']

jobs:
  analyze:
    name: Analyze (${{ matrix.language }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      security-events: write
      packages: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        language: [javascript-typescript]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
        with:
          languages: ${{ matrix.language }}
          # queries: security-and-quality   # uncomment for stricter rules

      - uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3
        with:
          category: '/language:${{ matrix.language }}'

      # Optional: Semgrep OSS as a second, fast opinion (free, no account)
      - name: Semgrep scan
        run: pipx run semgrep scan --config p/javascript --error --metrics=off projects/

name: SonarCloud

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  sonarcloud:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: SonarCloud Scan
        uses: SonarSource/sonarcloud-github-action@v3
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}

## 💬 What if your GitHub repository had its own developer? **One that doesn't just suggest solutions. It builds them.** You open an issue. Ariotica picks it up. It writes the application, checks its work, fixes what breaks, and publishes the result. **Your idea → A working app.**
## 👨‍💻 Meet the developer who lives in your repo | You say | Ariotica does | |:---|:---| | 🏗️ **Build this** | Creates a working application from your idea | | ✨ **Make it better** | Improves features, design, and behavior | | 🩹 **Fix this bug** | Investigates, patches, and tests the fix | | 🛡️ **Audit the code** | Checks for security issues and attempts repairs | | 🧠 **Remember this** | Reuses relevant patterns from previous work | | 🚀 **Ship it** | Commits the result to your repository | | 💬 **Explain this** | Answers questions about the project |

| 🚀 **Ship it** | Commits the result to your repository | | 💬 **Explain this** | Answers questions about the project | > **A chatbot gives you code to copy. Ariotica gives you work that's done.** --- ## 🪄 Ridiculously simple. Deliberately powerful.
### ZERO heavyweight frameworks. ONE working AI developer. **No Python. No LangChain. No vector database. No Docker. No dedicated server.** Just **JavaScript + GitHub + AI**. *Because building an agent shouldn't require building a second company to host it.*
Ariotica uses GitHub Issues as its task board, GitHub Actions as its workspace, and your repository as its delivery destination. No sprawling platform to install. No separate dashboard backend to maintain. **Free-tier friendly**, with optional AI provider keys and subject to provider quotas and GitHub usage limits. No promises of infinite free compute, because even robots have rate limits. --- ## 🔁 It doesn't stop at the first answer **Write → Check → Fix → Check again → Ship.**

**Write → Check → Fix → Check again → Ship.**

Ariotica is designed to catch problems before delivery, feed failures back into its generation loop, and try again. Its repository memory helps it reuse relevant patterns from earlier projects.

It's not magic, and automated checks aren't a substitute for a human review on critical software. It's a developer-shaped workflow that actually follows through.

---

## 🎮 Manage your developer with a comment

No complicated prompt console. Just talk to Ariotica where developers already work: **GitHub Issues**.

| Command | Assignment |
|:---|:---|
| `[BUILD] kanban` | Build a Kanban app |
| `[improve] add dark mode` | Upgrade the existing app |
| `[fix] cards don't save` | Repair the bug |
| `[audit]` | Review security and attempt fixes |
| `[ask] how does storage work?` | Explain the codebase |
| `[delete]` | Remove the app |

**Example:** Open an issue titled `[BUILD] habit-tracker` and describe what you want. The issue becomes the assignment; the resulting commit becomes the delivery.

A developer at work. **[Open the Ariotica Live Dashboard →](https://suryasticsai.github.io/Ariotica/)** - **Issue Mode:** Create an assignment through GitHub, without putting a token into the dashboard. - **Direct Mode:** Use a GitHub token with the necessary permissions to trigger supported workflows. - **Build Progress:** Follow available workflow progress and results. - **Delivered Apps:** Explore the projects committed to the repository. > **Security note:** Treat GitHub personal access tokens like passwords. Use fine-grained permissions and never commit tokens to source code. --- ## 🧩 The entire idea, in one picture ```text 💡 YOUR IDEA │ ▼ 📝 GITHUB ISSUE │ ▼ 🤖 ARIOTICA WORKS │ ┌────┴────┐ ▼ ▼ 🧠 REMEMBER 🛠️ BUILD │ ▼ 🛡️ CHECK │ Needs a fix? ↙ ↘

│ Needs a fix? ↙ ↘ YES NO │ │ 🩹 FIX │ │ │ └─►🔁─┘ │ ▼ 🚀 COMMIT │ ▼ ✨ YOUR APP ```
🔧 Curious about the engine? Ariotica is driven by JavaScript in GitHub Actions. Its agent workflow can combine AI provider fallback, lightweight repository search, code checks, and automated smoke tests. The aim is to keep the system understandable and avoid heavyweight orchestration frameworks. The generated applications favor lightweight vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Some development-time checks may use Node packages; **no heavyweight agent framework** does not necessarily mean **zero npm dependencies**.
